hero.subheadline: The modern coaching platform that unites training, physiology, psychology, and cyclical health.
hero.body: Create training programs that work for everyone — and give women a fairer foundation by accounting for the body's natural variations.

value.heading:
Training apps are built for linear bodies.
People are not linear.
value.body1: Most tools assume even energy, even recovery, and even performance.
value.body2: But that's not how real people work — and least of all clients whose physiology is affected by hormonal variations.
value.body3:
With JOMOA, coaches get a tool that works for everyone,
but also gives women better conditions by making visible patterns that are often overlooked.

insights.heading: Energy, motivation, and recovery vary — and that's completely normal.
insights.subheading:
This is not a problem.
It's information that makes training smarter.
items: Energy can shift 20–30% over a month
Recovery is affected by sleep, stress, and physiology
Performance goes in curves, not in a line

phases.heading: Support for different phases and conditions.
phases.body2: It's a tool that gives all clients the right support — and lets women get insights when they need them.

items.title: Periods with increased sensitivity or discomfort

phases.footer1: The client gets the right dose of educational insights.
phases.footer2: The coach gets relevant decision support.

data.heading: Data-driven — but human.

data.coach: "I can guide smarter and more confidently."
